correctness.rationale: For the rank-one dyad xy*, the normalized Pauli Hilbert–Schmidt Parseval identity gives |q|²+a+b+|z|²=2 with 0≤a,b≤1. The explicit determinant-zero, HS-unit dyad (r I+uX+vY)/2 with u=cosθ+i s sinθ, v=sinθ-i s cosθ realizes every a+b=1+s², s²≤a≤1. The exact finite-p maximization of α^p a^(p/2)+β^p(1+s²-a)^(p/2) is strictly concave for 1≤p<2, affine at 2, strictly convex for p>2; endpoint p=∞ is α. The stationary allocation Tα^k/(α^k+β^k) lies on the edge iff s≤(β/α)^(p/(2-p)). Both branches match at equality, with α=β and p=2 equality degeneracies treated. Independently checked rank-one constraints and the threshold for 369 bounded cases; that is not a universal proof.
residual_risks: Only 2x2 anticommuting Pauli X and Y, positive weights, interior |q|; no extension to all matrix tuples.
